language.label: Language
language.help: Choose the language for the AgentGuard interface. This is saved in your browser.

page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: View and edit AgentGuard server configuration. Keys set by environment variables or CLI flags are read-only.

banners.restartRequiredAfterSave: Saved. Some changes require an AgentGuard restart to take effect.
banners.restartRequired: Saved configuration differs from the running server — restart AgentGuard to apply.
banners.reprovisionRequired: DLP model settings differ from what's provisioned. Re-provision to apply baked-in model/dimension changes. (Changing the embedding dimension does not recreate the existing stream automatically.)

nav.stateRestart: Restart required to apply saved changes
nav.stateReprovision: Re-provision required to apply model changes

sentry.serverConfigDesc: Boot defaults stored in config.yaml — saved with the Save bar below. All other Sentry settings are edited live under Model configuration.
sentry.modelConfigDesc: Live state in the agentguard_sentry_config stream — changes apply immediately, with no restart or re-provision, independent of the Save bar. Renders regardless of Semantic DLP status.

dlp.serverConfigDesc: Boot defaults stored in config.yaml — saved with the Save bar below. All other DLP settings are edited live under Runtime configuration.
dlp.runtimeConfigDesc: Live state in the agentguard_dlp_config stream — changes apply immediately, with no restart or re-provision, independent of the Save bar.
dlp.reprovisionHint: Re-detects the embedding dimension and rebuilds the pipeline. Run after switching the embedding model.

source.envTitle: Set by {{envVar}} — file edits have no effect until the variable is removed
source.flagTitle: Set by --{{flag}} — file edits have no effect

server_port.label: HTTP port
server_port.description: Port the AgentGuard server listens on.

timeplus_database.label: Database
timeplus_database.description: Timeplus database holding the AgentGuard streams. Use "default" for a wizard-provisioned deployment, or the app's db_name (e.g. "ag") when the pipeline was installed as a Timeplus app.

timeplus_user.label: Service user
timeplus_user.description: Service account username. Set via the TIMEPLUS_USER environment variable only.

timeplus_password.label: Service password
timeplus_password.description: Service account password. Set via the TIMEPLUS_PASSWORD environment variable only.

rules_visible_packages.label: Visible rule packages
rules_visible_packages.description: Rule packages surfaced on the Rules page. Packages left unchecked (and their not-yet-installed rules) are hidden. Applied live.

ui_default_language.label: Default UI language
ui_default_language.description: Language shown to users who haven't picked one in their browser.

catalog_dir.label: Catalog directory
catalog_dir.description: Filesystem directory the rule catalog is loaded from.

holds_mv_wait_ms.label: MV wait (ms)
holds_mv_wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for a rule MV to evaluate before deciding a hold.

holds_timeout_seconds.label: Hold timeout (s)
holds_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds a hold waits for a human decision before failing (max 540).

holds_fail_policy.label: Fail policy
holds_fail_policy.description: What to do when a hold times out or the server shuts down.

holds_disabled.label: Disable holds
holds_disabled.description: When true, no PreToolUse holds are created.

dlp_enabled.label: Enable Semantic DLP
dlp_enabled.description: Turn on the Semantic DLP enrichment + query pipeline.

dlp_base_url.label: LLM base URL
dlp_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for DLP embedding/risk/summary models.

dlp_api_key.label: API key
dlp_api_key.description: Bearer key for the DLP LLM endpoint. Write-only; never displayed.

dlp_embedding_model.label: Embedding model
dlp_embedding_model.description: Model used to embed content. Baked into UDFs — change needs re-provision.

dlp_embedding_dim.label: Embedding dimension
dlp_embedding_dim.description: Auto-detected from the embedding model at provision (probed via dlp_embed). Read-only; the configured value is only a fallback used when the endpoint is unreachable.

dlp_risk_model.label: Risk model
dlp_risk_model.description: Model used for risk classification. Baked into UDFs — change needs re-provision.

dlp_summary_model.label: Summary model
dlp_summary_model.description: Model used for query summarization. Baked into UDFs — change needs re-provision.

dlp_request_timeout_seconds.label: Model request timeout (s)
dlp_request_timeout_seconds.description: Per-call timeout for DLP model requests. 5–55 (must stay under the 60s query client). Baked into UDFs — change needs re-provision.

dlp_max_output_tokens.label: Max output tokens
dlp_max_output_tokens.description: Token budget for risk/understand/rerank model calls (summary uses at least 800). Raise for reasoning models. Baked into UDFs — change needs re-provision.

sentry_enabled.label: Enable Sentry agent
sentry_enabled.description: Conversational security analyst agent (chat, SQL skills). Model settings live in agentguard_sentry_config, editable under Settings → Tabby Assistant.

sentry_skill_dir.label: SQL skill directory override
sentry_skill_dir.description: Optional path to an updated timeplus-sql-guide skill directory; empty uses the embedded copy.

sentry_chat_base_url.label: Sentry chat base URL
sentry_chat_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the Sentry chat model (boot default; edit live under Settings → Tabby Assistant).

sentry_chat_api_key.label: Sentry chat API key
sentry_chat_api_key.description: API key for the Sentry chat endpoint.

sentry_chat_model.label: Sentry chat model
sentry_chat_model.description: Tool-calling-capable chat model id for the Sentry agent loop.

sentry_chat_api_type.label: Sentry chat API type
sentry_chat_api_type.description: LLM API dialect for the Sentry chat model: 'openai' (Chat Completions) or 'anthropic' (Anthropic Messages, e.g. Claude on Bedrock).

sentry_memory_enabled.label: Enable Sentry memory (Phase 2)
sentry_memory_enabled.description: Enables Sentry's embedding-backed memory (Phase 2). When off, no embedding endpoint is needed.

sentry_embedding_base_url.label: Sentry embedding base URL
sentry_embedding_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the Sentry memory embedding model (may differ from chat, e.g. local Ollama).

sentry_embedding_api_key.label: Sentry embedding API key
sentry_embedding_api_key.description: API key for the Sentry embedding endpoint.

sentry_embedding_model.label: Sentry embedding model
sentry_embedding_model.description: Embedding model id for Sentry memory (Phase 2).

sentry_embedding_dim.label: Sentry embedding dimension
sentry_embedding_dim.description: Vector dimension of the Sentry embedding model (Phase 2 memory).

sentry_request_timeout_seconds.label: Sentry model request timeout (s)
sentry_request_timeout_seconds.description: Per-call timeout for Sentry model requests.

sentry_max_output_tokens.label: Sentry max output tokens
sentry_max_output_tokens.description: Per-completion token cap for the Sentry chat model.

setup_complete.label: Setup complete
setup_complete.description: Whether the setup wizard has been run.
